title: ATF attempt to link guest to the Oklahoma City bombing

tellings.quote: near as I can figure, the ATF was trying to punish me for not cooperating in their investigation by trying to link me to that that bombing.

plain: After he refused to cooperate with an investigation by the ATF, the US federal agency that handles firearms and explosives, the agency tried to tie him to the 1995 Oklahoma City bombing, says Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants. Colbern tells it as something that happened to him, and he believes it was a way to punish him. He mentions Timothy McVeigh and an unnamed author writing a book on Oklahoma City.
